notes: Pages are real, public postings rendered once by scripts/fetch_postings.py and replayed from fixtures/postings; title/company are scored against answer_key.json (its `method`/`checks`/`notes`).
The library starts with the one taught parser; every other layout must be learned (C8).
The scripted agent makes no model calls. AI calls per learn come from --learn-calls with their own kind and source; the browser-agent line is an estimate (assumption in numbers).
Questions and deploy approvals from learn threads are answered instantly by the harness like a person reading the page, and counted in learns_that_asked_a_person.

browser_agent_cumulative_ai_calls.assumption: Estimate, not run: a DOM-reading browser agent makes at least one model call per posting (read the page and pick title/company), then opens the tracker form, fills 5 fields, submits and checks the confirmation. At one model call per action step with fields batched in pairs, that is ~6 calls per posting, every posting, forever: it does not learn. Even at the floor of 1 call per posting the line rises by 1 per posting.
